requirement.statement: The web server SHALL accept injected trusted DomainContext registrations, load each bundle once, derive id and version only from its catalog context, reject duplicate context ids, freeze server-current capabilities separately from authoring facts, and expose explicit contract-owned context, catalog, operation, and preset projections without leaking seed, bindings, handlers, probes, functions, database resources, or mutable execution state.

case.given: an app with zero or multiple unique registrations
case.then: stable direct DTOs list and resolve only registered public catalog facts

case.given: two registrations whose bundle catalogs share one context id
case.then: creation rejects the duplicate even when versions differ

case.given: a bundle containing seed, bindings, handlers, and probes
case.then: only enumerated contract DTO fields plus current capabilities are present and no function or runtime state leaks

case.when: a context-scoped GET route is requested
case.then: HTTP 404 returns the stable DOMAIN_CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND transport shape

requirement.statement: The execute route SHALL resolve context through projected request facts, pass the original parsed body object unchanged to the matching runtime bundle with its frozen server-current capabilities, return every runtime success, partial, or failure envelope as HTTP 200, and produce truthful contract failure envelopes with no fallback bundle or invented facts for missing, invalid, unknown, or version-mismatched contexts.

case.given: a complete preset request fetched from the catalog
case.when: that JSON object is posted without edits
case.then: the runtime receives the same request values and execution returns a contract response

case.given: a request with missing or structurally invalid context
case.then: HTTP 200 returns REQUEST_VALIDATION_FAILED with independently projected nullable facts, no commit, no mutations, and null tree

case.given: a well-formed unknown context id or non-active version
case.then: HTTP 200 returns OPERATION_CATALOG_MISMATCH without selecting or allocating another bundle

case.given: a runtime success, partial, or business/execution failure
case.then: the unchanged response envelope is returned with HTTP 200

requirement.statement: The server SHALL preserve runtime per-execution lifecycle ownership for sequential and concurrent requests, SHALL preserve existing health and execute-kon routes, SHALL declare direct contract/runtime dependencies and a real build, and SHALL reject production imports from capsule, private/internal, generated distribution, node_modules, unallowlisted depa-orm subpaths, or test fixtures.

case.when: mutating requests run sequentially and concurrently
case.then: each response observes a fresh deterministic state and no request shares live database state

case.given: the server after Domain Operation integration
case.when: health and execute-kon regression cases run
case.then: their existing response contracts remain valid

case.given: web-server source, package metadata, and root scripts
case.when: focused tests, typecheck/build, root build, and import guards run
case.then: all pass using declared public package dependencies and the protected capsule hashes remain unchanged
